output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount of tokens purchased is determined by the value of the buy price, which is stored in the memory of the ExtremeToken contract.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount of tokens sold is determined by the value of the sell price, which is stored in the memory of the ExtremeToken contract.

The transfer function has an integer overflow where the amount of tokens transferred is determined by the value of the balance of the sender, which is stored in the memory of the ExtremeToken contract.
